Return JSON {"verdict": ..., "reason": "one sentence"}.
response: {"verdict":"unsupported","reason":"S201 has crews repeating critical location and destination details during fallback radio coordination, apparently to the Radio Coordinator, while S063 has the CAD Console checking location details entered at call intake, so no sentence shows the Paramedic Crew sending this item to the console."}
